violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: CFM ordered a food temperature measuring device immediately.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The handwashing sink at @LOCATION@ is equipped with separate cold and hot water faucets rather than a mixing valve or combination faucet. HOT WATER TEMPERATURE OF FRONT HAND SINK WAS 87F, HAND SINK AT THE ENTRANCE OF KITCHEN WAS 95F.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. PLEASE OBTAIN URGENT SERVICE FOR THE HAND SINKS WITHIN 10 CALENDAR DAYS.

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink. HAND SOAP WAS NOT PROVIDED AT THE HAND SINK NEAR 3-COMPARTMENT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. PLEASE PROVIDE HAND SOAP WITHIN 10 CALENDAR DAYS.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: TOMATO SOUP (57F), CHICKEN NOODLE SOUP (60F), GRILLED CHICKEN (78F), CHICKEN TIKKA (70F), AND TERIYAKI CHICKEN (54F) WERE STORED IN STEAM TABLE FOR ABOUT 20 MINUTES.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. EHS DISCUSSED REHEATING PROCESS WITH CFM. CFM REHEATED THE GRILLED CHICKEN TO 166F, CHICKEN TIKKA TO 167F, TERIYAKI CHICKEN TO 177F

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. OBSERVED CHIPS AND CONTAINERS IN CARTON BOXES WERE STORED ON FLOOR IN DRY STORAGE AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EHS EDUCATED THE CFM. CFM WILL RELOCATE THE FOOD.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions.
violations.corrective_action: CFM ORDERED A QUATERNARY AMMONIA TEST KIT IMMEDIATELLY.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Sanitizers, Criteria
violations.observation: The concentration of the SINK & SURFACE CLEANER SANITIZER solution was measured at 5.86 MILLILITRES/LITRE. This concentration exceeds the approved limits (2.11-4.30 MILLILITRES/LITRE) for use with food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils in a foodservice establishment.
violations.corrective_action: Maintain the concentration of SANITIZER solution at 2.11-4.30 MILLILITRES/LITRE. Verify concentration using the appropriate test kit. CFM WILL NEED TO MANUALLY ADJUST THE CONCENTRATION OF SANITIZER TO THE ACCEPTABLE RANGE.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: SANITIZER DISPENSER IS IN NEED OF CALIBRATION.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. PLEASE OBTAIN URGENT SERVICE FOR THE SANITIZER DISPENSER AND FORWARD THE SERVICE REPORT TO EHS WITHIN 10 CALENDAR DAYS.
